ideal_gas_law.description: State equation for ideal gas; relates P, V, T, n

first_law.description: Energy conservation: heat in - work out = energy change

entropy.latex: S = n C_v \ln(T) + n R \ln(V) + S_0
entropy.description: Entropy: measure of disorder; ∝ ln(T) and ln(V)

carnot_efficiency.description: Carnot efficiency: maximum efficiency of a heat engine between two reservoirs
carnot_efficiency.validation: η = 0 at T_c = T_h; η < 1 always (2nd Law)

polytropic_work.description: Work done by an ideal gas along a polytrope P V^n = const
polytropic_work.validation: Isobaric work equals P dV; adiabatic heat is zero

isothermal_work.description: Work done by an ideal gas on an isotherm (n = 1)
isothermal_work.validation: Temperature unchanged along the path, so dU = 0

maxwell_entropy_volume.description: Maxwell relation for an ideal gas, checked by finite differences
maxwell_entropy_volume.validation: Finite-difference values agree with nR/V to 1e-6

maxwell_entropy_pressure.description: Second Maxwell relation for an ideal gas, checked by finite differences
